message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through the attic for our old board games. It was a delightful trip down memory lane! As I set them up on the kitchen table, I remembered how much fun we used to have gathered around, laughing and competing over a simple game of Monopoly. 🃏 It hit me that while it’s important to have our go-bags ready and documents organized, it's just as crucial to have moments of joy and connection. Sometimes, rediscovering low-tech fun is the best kind of preparedness! What’s your favorite way to unplug?
